mapper.insert: INSERT INTO life_retrieval_queue (id, batch_id, node_id, series, title, query, priority, est_cost, status, result, from_cache, created_at, decided_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{batch_id}, #{node_id}, #{series}, #{title}, #{query}, #{priority}, #{est_cost}, #{status}, #{result}, #{from_cache}, #{created_at}, #{decided_at}, #{updated_at})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM life_retrieval_queue ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM life_retrieval_queue ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM life_retrieval_queue WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, est_cost FROM life_retrieval_queue WHERE status = 'pending' AND (batch_id IS NULL OR batch_id = '') ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT id, batch_id FROM life_retrieval_queue WHERE batch_id <> ''
SELECT * FROM life_retrieval_queue WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = 'pending'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM life_retrieval_queue WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE life_retrieval_queue SET status = 'rejected', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE life_retrieval_queue SET result = #{result}, status = 'done', from_cache = #{fromCache}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE life_retrieval_queue SET status = 'failed', result = #{result}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
